notes.title: 🎮 Join the Childkin Community on Discord! 🌟
notes.notes:
Hey Adventurers!

We’re thrilled to invite you to join our cozy Childkin Discord server! Whether you want to chat about game development, share ideas, or just hang out with fellow cozy game lovers, our growing community is the perfect spot.

✨ Why Join?

Get exclusive updates on the game
Chat with the developers (that's us!)
Share your thoughts and influence the development
Connect with other players who love creative, wholesome games
🔗 [url=https://discord.gg/PyFRCGYUZT]Clock here to visit Discord[/url] on Discord!

We can't wait to hear your thoughts and build this magical adventure together. See you there! 🎉

Warm hugs,
The Childkin Dev Team

notes.title: Thank You for Adding Us to Your Wishlist! 💖
notes.notes:
Hey, Childkin Community! 🌿

We want to extend our heartfelt thanks to each and every one of you who added Childkin to your wishlist. Your support means the world to us and gives us the motivation to keep building this warm, relationship-driven game filled with cozy adventures.

Every "Add to Wishlist" click helps us reach more players and shows that our vision is finding a place in your hearts.

We're just two brothers with a passion for creating games that bring peace, creativity, and warmth to everyday life. There's still plenty of work ahead, but your encouragement makes it all worthwhile!

What’s Next?
Expect updates on development progress and behind-the-scenes looks.
We’ll also be sharing sneak peeks and exclusive content as we move forward.
💖 Stay with us and be part of this wonderful journey!
Every question, suggestion, or kind word means the world to us, so don't hesitate to reach out!

Thank you once again, and see you soon in Childkin! 🌟
